easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Acrobatic Maneuver.
description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Acrobatic Maneuver, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Acrobatic Maneuver, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
